about: bsv-low #836 (loop 44, record 1066, 2026-10-22): Arcade's REJECTED for a pre-signed refund presented at its lock height while Arcade's peer answered thirteen blocks behind the chain (the chain's tip 972185, the peer's 972172). Two refunds (pot_evictions 1902ca00afb99f73... at 16:53:08Z and c76c3a09634c316c... at 16:52:58Z) were evicted on it. The bodies are frozen from the ledger's reason (the extraInfo verbatim: 'TX_LOCK_TIME (35): lock time (972185) as block height is not less than block height (972172)') joined to Arcade's own non-final suffix as arcade@85bfe5d writes it (services/propagation/propagator.go:1796-1798, classifyFailureLine: TX_LOCK_TIME maps to 476 StatusNotFinal and gains the retryable hint); the HTTP bytes themselves were not captured. Placeholders: {TXID} the subject txid. Expectations are this overlay's readings (bsv-low #836): a non-final word is 'not now', never a refusal, never an eviction.
